limitations: Scalar types represent the observed ARM64 calling ABI; original typedef names and some method names are unrecoverable from stripped symbols.
Slot 175 action width has one observed family caller; native OTG ignores the action.
Do not call unrecovered abiSlot functions through their placeholder C++ signatures.
Original addresses must be transformed using emitted module extents.
DWC3 TRB ownership, short packets, cancellation and setup/status phase transitions still require a real hardware adapter and device validation.

controller_fields.0x130: USB string dictionary/list created by finishInitialization

ep0_sequence: In controller workloop/gate: native_usb_control_input_setup(control, setup8). This method returns void.
Then native_usb_control_process_setup(control). DWC2 separates packet receipt from setup phase complete; DWC3 should run both when its 8-byte SETUP TRB completes.
OUT data packets and the host OUT status ZLP are submitted as native_usb_control_input_data(control, bytes, receivedLength).
IN data/status writes arrive at hardware through ioGated with endpoint=0x80; complete them through native_usb_complete_io to run the original status/data callback.
On USB bus reset, native_usb_control_reset(control) then inherited handleUSBReset() (slot196). The original DWC2 performs exactly this before rearming EP0.
Cable connect and disconnect notifications use inherited slots203 and204. These methods internally run on the native gate.
Suspend/resume notifications use slots195/197, while already in the native workloop.
